description: Only pure `| indent` supported for now, without the `first` flag since that would require massive changes to the Jinja engine.

comments.body:
Added two more tests as I think this has issues due to `getline` eating newlines without telling you.

Also, you can simply prefill `indented` outside the loop if `first` is true, should simplify the block.
Yeah, I just decided on "don't fix it if it ain't broken" for this one :)
